dedupe_keys.name: db infrago infrastructure register isr interactive map principles and isr data service for the german rail network

description: The Infrastructure Register (Infrastrukturregister, ISR) of DB InfraGO AG is the information system on the rail infrastructure that DB InfraGO operates in Germany, made up of a text part (Grundsätze, the principles) and an interactive route-based map, the ISR viewer. Coverage: the DB InfraGO network in Germany; the principles describe the DB infrastructure managers, the legal and technical background and technical parameters too complex for the map, with annexes on tunnel lengths, loading-gauge route clearance (DE2 and DE3), minimum contact wire heights below 495 cm and exceptions for operating points; the map shows line-related information including the TEN route categories under the TSI Infrastructure regulation, track plans, and for each operating point whether its tracks belong to the running lines or to service facilities, with links to the facilities portal. The ISR Data Service returns current register data for the whole network (platforms, operating points, line sections and tunnels) as JSON from a URL, with filters, for the current network timetable version. Format and access: web map viewer (JavaScript, optimised for Chrome), PDF principles and annexes, and the JSON data service; the viewer and documents are public. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: the ISR Data Service is listed among DB InfraGO's ancillary services and its terms, cost and endpoint documentation were not read; the viewer could not be read without scripts. Simulation uses: clearances, tunnels, platforms and operating points for rail network capacity and disruption models. Related records: DB's open data and APIs (data-deutsche-bahn-open-data-and-apis) give the network geometry and station data, and ERA's RINF (data-era-rinf) is the EU-wide register of rail infrastructure.
